- **`EvaluationTests.cs`** — two evaluation tests that send prompts to the chat client and run AI quality evaluators against the responses.

**Packages used:**
- `Aspire.Hosting.Testing` — integration testing for Aspire apps
- `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation` — core evaluation framework
- `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.Quality` — quality evaluators
- `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.Reporting` — result reporting

Run evaluations with `dotnet test MyApp.Evaluations/` (requires a configured Azure OpenAI endpoint at runtime).
